profile.headline: IT Professional
profile.geoLocationName: North Brunswick, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Results-driven Principal Software Engineer with extensive experience leading development teams, managing large-scale applications, and architecting cloud-based solutions. With a Master’s degree in Computer Science and a deep technical background, I bridge the gap between engineering and leadership, driving innovation and efficiency in software development.

Over two decades of experience in software engineering, team leadership, and cloud infrastructure management, including AWS cost optimization, system architecture, and full-stack development. Adept at working in fast-paced, agile environments and managing globally distributed teams. Passionate about building scalable, high-performance web applications and ensuring seamless DevOps operations.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Risepoint, I lead software development and architecture for Engage LMS, a custom Moodle-based Learning Management System, while also driving innovation through AI/ML solutions.
	•	AI/ML Development: Built a Python and FastAPI-based application that ingests structured/unstructured student orientation data (PDFs, databases), generates embeddings with Ollama, and upserts into Qdrant vector DB, enabling semantic search and natural language Q&A for students. Integrated Postgres for structured storage and developed data pipelines for scalable ingestion.
	•	LMS Engineering: Design and implement new features for Engage LMS, enhance existing functionality, and ensure scalability, performance, and security.
	•	System Architecture: Oversee architecture decisions, optimize performance, and provide technical leadership to ensure the platform evolves with customer and industry needs.
	•	Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, academic, and support teams to deliver high-quality, innovative solutions tailored to the education sector.
positions.insights: Skills: FastAPI · Python (Programming Language) · Ollama · Qdrant · AI/ML · Azure Databricks · AI Software Development · OpenAI API · Embeddiings · Heroku · PHP Applications · Ruby · Java · React.js · REST APIs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Next.js · Spring Boot · RESTful WebServices · Databases

positions.title: Manager - Application Development
positions.description: At John Wiley & Sons, I managed and developed enterprise web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and cloud-based architectures while designing and architecting highly available systems to deliver learning content to universities nationwide. Leading a cross-functional engineering team, I ensured compliance with LTI and IMSCC specifications for seamless e-learning integration. Additionally, I spearheaded AWS infrastructure management, overseeing EC2, ELB, RDS, CloudFront, and Dockerized applications to optimize performance, scalability, and reliability.

positions.title: Tech Lead Sr Web Application Developer
positions.description:
At Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia, I contributed to the growth of the company’s digital ecosystem by developing scalable web solutions, enhancing online commerce, and optimizing content delivery.
	•	API & System Integration: Designed and implemented API-driven solutions to streamline data exchange with external vendors and business partners.
	•	E-Commerce Development: Built and integrated new online shopping features, improving functionality, scalability, and customer experience.
	•	Content Management Enhancements: Upgraded and extended content management workflows, enabling more efficient publishing and richer digital experiences.
	•	Cross-Team Collaboration: Partnered with product, design, and marketing teams to deliver high-quality web solutions that supported business goals and expanded digital engagement.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Led migration from Vignette CMS to Adobe Day Communiqué, enhancing content management, streamlining workflows, and improving editorial efficiency.
	•	Developed a high-performance J2EE web application for Sprint and its joint venture partners, enabling seamless bundled sales of wireless services.
	•	Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements, deliver scalable solutions, and ensure adoption through testing, documentation, and training.
